concerns.text: The plan assumes a participant‑level linkage between the American Gut Project (AGP) and the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) via a shared `participant_id` (see the overlap check: *"If overlap < 500, the pipeline logs the count and terminates…"*). Publicly available AGP and HRS datasets do not contain a common identifier, so this linkage is infeasible. Relying on a non‑existent overlap makes the core analysis (merged dataset, correlation, modeling) impossible, violating FR‑001 and Principle VI of the constitution. The pipeline must either obtain a truly linked microbiome‑cognition dataset or redesign the study to avoid the impossible merge.
